#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

class Analyzer {
private:
    int len = 0;
    int max_len = 0;
    int count = 0;
    bool inside = false;

public:
    void handle(char c) {
        if (c == '_') {
            if (len > 0) {
                if (inside) count++;
                else max_len = std::max(max_len, len);
            }
            len = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            if (len > 0) max_len = std::max(max_len, len);
            len = 0;
            inside = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (len > 0) count++;
            len = 0;
            inside = false;
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }

    void finish() {
        if (len > 0) max_len = std::max(max_len, len);
    }

    void print() {
        printf("%d %d\n", max_len, count);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    char s[256];
    scanf("%s", s);

    Analyzer analyzer;
    for (int i = 0; s[i] != '\0'; i++) analyzer.handle(s[i]);
    analyzer.finish();
    analyzer.print();

    return 0;
}
